def hex_vertices(cx, cy, angle_deg=0.0):
    """Return 6 vertices of a unit hexagon centered at (cx,cy) with given rotation."""
    a = math.radians(angle_deg)
    verts = []
    for k in range(6):
        theta = a + k * math.pi / 3.0
        verts.append((cx + math.cos(theta), cy + math.sin(theta)))
    return verts

def polygons_overlap(v1, v2, eps=1e-9):
    """Check if two convex polygons overlap using separating axis theorem."""
    edges = []
    for i in range(len(v1)):
        j = (i + 1) % len(v1)
        ex = v1[j][0] - v1[i][0]
        ey = v1[j][1] - v1[i][1]
        edges.append((-ey, ex))
    for i in range(len(v2)):
        j = (i + 1) % len(v2)
        ex = v2[j][0] - v2[i][0]
        ey = v2[j][1] - v2[i][1]
        edges.append((-ey, ex))
    
    for nx, ny in edges:
        proj1 = [v[0]*nx + v[1]*ny for v in v1]
        proj2 = [v[0]*nx + v[1]*ny for v in v2]
        min1, max1 = min(proj1), max(proj1)
        min2, max2 = min(proj2), max(proj2)
        if max1 < min2 + eps or max2 < min1 + eps:
            return False
    return True

def check_no_overlap(pts, angle_deg=0.0):

            if polygons_overlap(hexes[i], hexes[j]):
                return False
    return True
